members.assessment: The surname 陸 in Kong Huan’s 潘、陸之華 is a paired literary exemplar, not the present interlocutor Lu Yu. The exact parallel Nanshi027 and the explicit Jin Pan–Lu pairing Jin117, with Liang049’s named Taikang Lu Ji/Pan Anren bridge, support the inherited strongly-inferred Lu Ji reading. No stronger personal-name certainty or new surname alias is invented.

primaryQuotes.zh: 奐謂瑜曰：「江有潘、陸之華，而無園、綺之實，輔弼儲宮，竊有所難。」

members.assessment: Full 陸機 commands for Sima Ying against the capital and is defeated at Jianchun Gate; matching patron, campaign and defeat connect the general to the Lu Ji of Jin071/Song030.

primaryQuotes.zh: 顒遣其將張方，穎遣其將陸機、牽秀、石超等來逼京師。
戊申，破陸機于建春門，石超走，斬其大將賈崇等十六人，懸首銅駝街。

members.assessment: 黃門郎陸機 is arrested after Lun’s fall in the precise same court milieu as the Minhuai elegist and the ZZT083 Lun staff appointee. His own role is distinct from Fu Zhi, Sun Xiu and the other detainees.

primaryQuotes.zh: 及倫敗，齊王冏收侍中劉逵、常侍騶捷、杜育、黃門郎陸機、右丞周導、王尊等付廷尉。

members.assessment: Target anchor: the named former minister 陸機 composes a dirge with Jiang Tong after Minhuai’s burial. It establishes the Jin court writer, not an anonymous funeral participant.

primaryQuotes.zh: 帝感閻纘之言，立思子台，故臣江統、陸機並作誄頌焉。

members.assessment: Sima Ying’s 前鋒都督陸機 receives the specific Wang Cui warning from Sun Hui, then he and his brothers are executed. Sanguozhi051 repeats the same patron, campaign, warning and fate, naming younger brothers Yun and Dan.

primaryQuotes.zh: 是時，穎將征長沙王乂，以陸機為前鋒都督。
惠與機同鄉里，憂其致禍，勸機讓都督于王粹。
及機兄弟被戮，惠甚傷恨之。

members.assessment: 晉之潘、陸 explicitly contrasts Jin literary exemplars with Wei’s Chen/Xu in Lü Chao’s reported comparison of Zong Chang. Same Pan–Lu pairing as the named Taikang writer, not a Later Qin contemporary.

primaryQuotes.zh: 超曰：「敞在西土，時論甚美，方敞魏之陳、徐，晉之潘、陸。」

members.assessment: Taizong’s four Jinshu discussions name 陸機 beside Jin emperors Xuan/Wu and Wang Xizhi in the compilation history. He is the earlier Jin biography subject, not a Tang compiler or contemporary.

primaryQuotes.zh: 太宗自著宣、武二帝及陸機、王羲之四論，於是總題云「御撰」。

members.assessment: The retrospective comparison explicitly attributes 豪士 to 陸機; Nanqishu042 names the same author and work. Preserve the allusion frame without treating the Tang speaker date as Lu Ji’s life.

primaryQuotes.zh: 鳳閣侍郎蘇味道、李嶠見而嘆曰：「陸機《豪士》所不及也。」

members.assessment: Lu Chui calls him 吾家平原 and recalls his visit to 張壯武. Song081 explicitly names 晉平原內史陸機, supplying the specific title bridge, while the speaker’s clan relationship and recalled visit stay intact.

primaryQuotes.zh: 陸倕聞之歎曰：「劉郎可謂差人，雖吾家平原詣張壯武，王粲謁伯喈，必無此對。」

members.assessment: Explicit 陸機 is the Taikang literary leader paired with 安仁/景陽; the surrounding dynasty-by-dynasty literary survey distinguishes him from later Liang contemporaries and establishes the Pan–Lu literary bridge.

primaryQuotes.zh: 陸機爲太康之英，安仁、景陽爲輔；

members.assessment: 士衡 is the literary model paired with 安仁, in exactly the parallel Nanshi043 judgment. Xintangshu078’s explicit 陸士衡 bridges surname and courtesy form; no personal alias is invented.

primaryQuotes.zh: 但康樂放蕩，作體不辨有首尾，安仁、士衡深可宗尚，顏延之抑 其次也。」

members.assessment: Explicit 陸機 is author of 豪士 in the historian’s closing assessment; the same named author/work appears in Jiutangshu106. A historical author quoted as an exemplar, not a current Qi participant.

primaryQuotes.zh: 陸機所以賦豪士也。

members.assessment: Kong Huan’s exact 潘、陸之華 allusion matches Chenshu021 in speaker, Jiang Zong appointment dispute and literary contrast. Lu here is the classic Jin literary partner of Pan, not the nearby messenger Lu Yu.

primaryQuotes.zh: 奐曰：「江有潘、陸之華，而無園、綺之實，輔弼儲貳，竊謂非材。」

members.assessment: 士衡 paired with 安仁 in Xiao Daocheng’s evaluation exactly matches Nanqishu035, with Xintangshu078 explicitly providing 陸士衡. Preserve the courtesy-name occurrence.

primaryQuotes.zh: 但康樂放蕩，作體不辨有首尾，安仁、士衡深可宗尚，顏延之抑其次也。」

members.assessment: The condemned Xiao Keng recites 陸機吊魏武, a named earlier author and specific work. The later Yanxing execution is the quoting event, not Lu Ji’s activity date.

primaryQuotes.zh: 及延興元年，明帝誅高、武、文惠諸子，鏗聞之，馮左右從容雅步，詠陸機吊魏武云：「昔以四海為己任，死則以愛子托人。」

members.assessment: Annotation explicitly quotes 陸機大墓賦 as a later literary illustration of 槥. The author’s name/work identifies the Jin writer; Cao Pi’s narrated reign does not place Lu Ji in Wei service.

primaryQuotes.zh: 陸機大墓賦曰：「觀細木而悶遲，覩洪櫝而念槥。」〉

members.assessment: Lu Ji commands Ying’s advance against Changsha, receives Sun Hui’s warning to yield to Wang Cui, and dies with younger brothers Yun/Dan. The exact parallel Jin071 event and Song086 機、雲 death establish the same man.

primaryQuotes.zh: 是时颖将有事於长沙，以陆机为前锋都督。
惠与机乡里亲厚，忧其致祸，谓之曰：“子盍让都督於王粹乎？”
机曰：“将谓吾避贼首鼠，更速其害。”
机寻被戮，二弟云、耽亦见杀，惠甚伤恨之。

members.assessment: The Sun Cheng appendix retrospectively names 陆机 as Chengdu Prince’s 大都督 and states Cheng became his 司馬 and died with him. Same patron/campaign/fate as the other commander records; printed 永安 is preserved without date repair.

primaryQuotes.zh: 永安中，陆机为成都王大都督，请丞为司马，与机俱被害。〉

members.assessment: The annotation explicitly attributes a Gu Tan biography to 陆机. The context is a quoted literary source and the accepted Lu Ji-of-Jin identity name, not a Gu Tan contemporary; no imported year is used as proof.

primaryQuotes.zh: 〈陆机为谭传曰：宣太子正位东宫，天子方隆训导之义，妙简俊彦，讲学左右。

members.assessment: Yu Zhong recognizes the named 吴郡陆机 while Lu Ji is a child, in the Wu-to-Jin biographical appendix. The distinctive Wu origin and later literary fame fit the same writer without extending a lifespan from this identity decision.

primaryQuotes.zh: 贞固幹事，好识人物，造吴郡陆机於童龀之年，称上虞魏迁於无名之初，终皆远致，为著闻之士。

members.assessment: 顾荣、陆机、陆云 jointly recommend He Xun after Wu’s fall. The named Lu Yun association and Wu-to-Jin court setting connect the writer to the brothers executed in Sanguozhi051/Song086; coauthors remain distinct.

primaryQuotes.zh: 顾荣、陆机、陆云表荐循曰：“伏见吴兴武康令贺循德量邃茂，才鉴清远，服膺道素，风操凝峻，历践三城，刑政肃穆，守职下县，编名凡萃，出自新邦，朝无知己，恪居遐外，志不自营，年时倏忽，而邈无阶绪，实州党愚智所为怅然。
臣等并以凡才，累授饰进，被服恩泽，忝豫朝末，知良士后时，而守局无言，惧有蔽贤之咎，是以不胜愚管，谨冒死表闻。”

members.assessment: Explicit Jin Hui/Taian2 frame names Lu Ji sent by Sima Ying against Changsha Yi, routed and executed. Same campaign/patron/fate as Jin004/Jin071 and Sanguozhi051; the corrupted English 代王 interpretation is not identity proof.

primaryQuotes.zh: 晉惠帝太安二年，成都王穎使陸機率眾向京師，擊長沙王乂。
軍始引而牙竿折，俄而戰敗，機被誅。
機又以穎得遐邇心，將為漢之代王，遂委質於穎，為犯從之將。

members.assessment: The narrator says no writers since named 潘岳、陸機 matched Yan Yanzhi/Xie Lingyun. This is a clear earlier literary pair, with no inference that the exemplars are contemporary with the later subjects.

primaryQuotes.zh: 延之與陳郡謝靈運俱以詞彩齊名，自潘岳、陸機之後，文士莫及也，江左稱顏、謝焉。

members.assessment: The family account explicitly names 晉平原內史陸機 as Gu Qian’s wife’s brother. This supplies the specific Pingyuan office-name bridge used by Liang040’s clan allusion; kinship is retained as written.

primaryQuotes.zh: 高祖謙，字公讓，晉平原內史陸機姊夫。

members.assessment: 士衡 is the named source of 同川而異歸 in the essay’s argument. The courtesy form matches explicit 陸士衡 in Xintangshu078 and the paired literary model in Nanqishu035/Nanshi043, not a later essay speaker.

primaryQuotes.zh: 樊生沖矯，鐫旌善之文，華子高抗，銘懲非之策，皆士衡所雲「同川而異歸」者也。

members.assessment: The retrospective comparison names Lu Kang and says 機、雲 were executed in the upper state. This is the same Lu Ji/Lu Yun kinship/fate bridge found explicitly in Sanguozhi051, and all four existing component members are retained.

primaryQuotes.zh: 陸抗定西陵，步氏禍及嬰孩，而機、雲為戮上國。

members.assessment: The dying Yuan Xi writes 昔...陸機想華亭鶴唳, plainly recalling an earlier condemned Lu Ji. The distinctive Huating crane allusion identifies the Jin writer; existing AD520 metadata belongs to the recalling frame and is separately flagged, not endorsed.

primaryQuotes.zh: 昔李斯憶上蔡黃犬，陸機想華亭鶴唳，豈不以恍惚無際，一去不還者乎？

members.assessment: 陸機則晉朝之秀 explicitly names the Jin literary exemplar. Its genuine name/role/assessment evidence s0008 establishes identity; the stray historicity evidence s0014 about Yuan Yue and the Cao Zhi contemporary relation are excluded from identity proof and typed for separate QA.

primaryQuotes.zh: 曹植信魏世之英，陸機則晉朝之秀，雖同時並列，分途爭遠。
袁躍，字景騰，陳郡人，尚書翻弟也。

members.assessment: 蕭衍’s 曹植、陸機復生於北土 is praise of Wen Zisheng by comparison with earlier writers. 復生 marks an allusion, not literal survival or a new Northern Wei Lu Ji.

primaryQuotes.zh: 衍稱之曰：「曹植、陸機復生於北土。

members.assessment: Compatible but unproved: the isolated 陸機 attribution at Wei111s0008 names no courtesy, office, family or independently identified work. No rival-identity marker proves separation; the unsupported AD289 point is excluded. Preserve the record as possible-same-as to Jin053p067, outside the31-member merge.

primaryQuotes.zh: 七曜一也，而分為二志，故陸機云學者所疑也。

members.assessment: Li Baiyao disputes 陸士衡’s enfeoffment argument; the next section shortens the comparison to 曹、陸. Explicit surname plus courtesy name bridges the Shiheng allusions and marks an earlier author, not a Tang participant.

primaryQuotes.zh: 又舉春秋二百四十二年之禍，亟於哀、平、桓、靈，而詆曹元首、陸士衡之言以為繆悠。
大抵與曹、陸相上下。

members.assessment: Named 殿中郎陸機 is recruited as 參軍 by Lun, in the same Minhuai/Jia/Lun court sequence as Jin053 and Jin047. All candidate raw083 pins remain current6d90; future approved English-source changes require genuine per-scope delta reconciliation.

primaryQuotes.zh: 相國倫欲收入望，選用海內名德之士，以前平陽太守李重、滎陽太守荀組為左、右長史，東平王堪、沛國劉謨為左、右司馬，尚書郎陽平束皙為記室，淮南王文學荀嵩、殿中郎陸機為參軍。
